hints.title: Two Symmetric Subproblems
hints.text: The problem requires finding Type 1 triplets (nums1[i]^2 == nums2[j] * nums2[k]) and Type 2 triplets (nums2[i]^2 == nums1[j] * nums1[k]).

hints.title: Pair Product Frequency Table
hints.text: Compute all pairwise products nums[j] * nums[k] for j < k, and store their counts in a lookup structure.

hints.title: Sum Match Counts
hints.text: For each element x in the other array, add the frequency of x * x from the product lookup structure to the total count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all triplets naively takes O(N1 * N2^2 + N2 * N1^2) which is cubic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precalculating pair product frequencies reduces lookup to O(1) per squared element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles 64-bit integer overflow when multiplying large values up to 10^5.
complexity.notes: Watch out for 32-bit overflow when squaring values.
